name: demo-recording
description: Record narrated, subtitled product demo videos of the live app from a versioned script (Playwright + Kokoro TTS + ffmpeg): it first reads the section and interviews you about scope, audience and data, then shows the script for approval before recording anything. The .demo.yml reads like a user story and carries no selectors; the engine adds a visible cursor, narration the pacing is built around, one-line passing subtitles, a coverage catalog of what you still have nothing to show for, and publishing to S3 with no binaries in git.
